Rounded tab bar used on the account pages and as the Area Coordinator sub-navigation.

- Coordinator tabs: Overview, Monthly Records, Points, Club events, Team approvals, New clubs, Waitlists. The account tabs are Overview, My registrations, Profile, Club coordination (coordinators only) and Help.
- 44px tabs in `--muted`; the current tab is a filled `--imsda-navy` pill with white text.
- An optional uppercase group label in navy names the role ("Area coordinator").
- **Approved Nov 9, 2026 (not built yet):** on phones the Area Coordinator sub-navigation is the same five-slot bottom bar as the club portal (Overview, Clubs, Events, Records, More; see `PhoneHeader`). The account pages (Overview, My registrations, Profile, Help) fit as tabs and stay tabs.
